items.q: How early should I book my decorator?
items.a: For peak season (November to February) book 4 to 6 months ahead. For other months 6 to 8 weeks is usually enough.
Yes. We regularly work across Uttar Pradesh and take destination projects. Travel and stay are quoted separately.

items.q: Can I see a design before I confirm?
items.a: Yes. After the venue visit you receive a moodboard and layout, and 3D visuals on larger projects.
A booking advance locks your date, with the balance in stages as the project progresses. Exact terms are in your quote.

items.q: Can you work within a fixed budget?
items.a: Absolutely. Tell us your budget upfront and we will design the best version of your idea inside it.
